title.narrative: Co-creating Green Safe Space: Engaging Youth

description.narrative: RETZ and 4H are implementing a pilot project entitled, �Co-creating Green Safe Space: Tackling Polarization through Youth-led Sustainable Food Production�. This engagement activity will support the anchoring of our work with sustainability and engagement of youth in activities to combat climate change by bringing selected members of the project group together for the launch of DUF climate tools on January 22nd. By participating in the launch event, the project group will be immediately ready to bring the tools back andimplement them within the pilot project itself, where the participants will act as multipliers for dissemination of the DUF climate tools among young people in 4H and RETZ, as well as the local communities where we operate.
